tasks.short: Conduct preliminary hearings and decide issues

steps.what: Conduct preliminary hearings and hear the parties on disputed issues
Decide preliminary issues and state the judicial determination

tasks.design: Keep the hearing and preliminary determination with the judge. The case record in {DOCS} supports the hearing without replacing judicial reasoning.
tasks.previous_blocker: Hearing evidence and applying the relevant legal test require judicial judgment.
tasks.enabler_now: No replacement is proposed for hearing or determination.
tasks.still_hard: Assessing disputed facts and explaining the applicable test fairly.
tasks.human_edge: Hear the parties and take responsibility for the determination.
tasks.altitude: Hearing time and judicial authority stay unchanged.

evidence.claim: The digest distinguishes judicial judgment and courtroom work from administrative automation.

assumptions: Boundary covers the preliminary hearing and its determination, excluding scheduling and separate written decision preparation.
Parties produce submissions and the judge hears them in s1; court staff maintain the existing case record. No structured probable-cause or detention-eligibility flag is assumed.
The task wording is jurisdiction-specific; actual procedural tests and authority must be confirmed locally.
Test existing record retrieval before additions; zero upkeep because no new system is introduced.
unknowns: Jurisdiction and local preliminary hearing procedure
research_questions: Which hearing record details are needed to explain the determination accurately?

approvals.approved_version: Exact case record snapshot, determination and stated reasons; changes require renewed judicial determination

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 gross and net zero. Contested and uncontested preliminary issues both retain the judge's hearing and decision work.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Grant divorces and divide marital assets

steps.what: Assess divorce applications, disputed facts and proposed asset division
Grant or refuse divorce and determine division of assets

tasks.design: The judge assesses the parties' evidence in {DOCS} and determines divorce and asset division. No automatic eligibility, valuation or entitlement decision is introduced.
tasks.previous_blocker: Contested evidence and legal entitlements require judicial judgment.
tasks.enabler_now: No verified change replaces the substantive decision in this task.
tasks.still_hard: Reconciling incomplete financial evidence and competing claims.
tasks.human_edge: Make and explain a fair, legally grounded determination.
tasks.altitude: Assessment and decision rights remain unchanged.

reach.learn: Keep asserted values distinct from judicial findings

evidence.claim: General legal drafting capability does not establish replacement of divorce or asset division judgment.

assumptions: Boundary is adjudication, excluding separate drafting support, registry administration and execution of asset transfers.
Parties produce financial evidence through the existing procedure; the judge evaluates completeness and values during s1. No free structured asset register or entitlement flag is assumed.
National divorce procedure and the judge's powers require local confirmation.
Test existing case tools before additions; zero upkeep because no new process is proposed.
unknowns: Jurisdiction, disputed issues and evidence completeness
research_questions: Which disputed valuations require further evidence rather than arithmetic?

approvals.approved_version: Exact parties, case evidence snapshot, divorce ruling and asset division with reasons; changes void acceptance

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 gives zero gross and net. Agreement may simplify the case but no technology-related saving is claimed.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Participate in judicial tribunals, deliberate with colleagues and help resolve disputes

tasks.design: Retain the judge's tribunal participation and deliberation. The record in {DOCS} supports collective reasoning, without automating the judicial contribution.
tasks.previous_blocker: Deliberation requires weighing arguments and engaging with other judges.
tasks.enabler_now: No verified substitute for that participation is proposed.
tasks.still_hard: Resolve disagreement while preserving independent judgment.
tasks.human_edge: Contribute accountable legal reasoning to a collective process.

reach.learn: Separate disagreements about facts from disagreements about law

evidence.claim: The supplied evidence does not demonstrate replacement of judicial panel participation.

assumptions: Boundary is this judge's participation; other members' labour and separate formal decision issuance are excluded.
Court staff maintain the existing record; parties and colleagues produce live arguments during the tribunal. No structured dispute-resolution outcome is assumed as an input.
Test native record access before additions; no new tool is proposed.
Zero upkeep because no new system or process is introduced.
research_questions: Which information gaps obstruct productive deliberation?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100; gross and net zero. Unanimous and divided panels retain human participation.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Explain the judicial system to the public

steps.what: Select public judicial information, audience and communication boundaries
Draft explanations for media appearances or public speeches

loop.purpose: Draft accessible explanations from approved public information
loop.input: Public brief with exact source passages and audience
loop.check: Judge checks accuracy, neutrality, confidentiality and whether simplification changes legal meaning
loop.stop: One draft and one revision; any unsupported legal explanation is rewritten manually
loop.why_not_simpler: Templates handle structure but audience-specific explanatory prose needs contextual wording

steps.what: Check the explanation, provide information publicly and answer questions

tasks.design: Use approved public explanations and {DOCS} templates first; a bounded drafting loop may adapt prose for an audience. The judge checks the exact prepared explanation and retains delivery and spontaneous answers.
tasks.previous_blocker: Public explanation needs careful plain-language adaptation.
tasks.enabler_now: Drafting can propose wording from an explicit public source pack.
tasks.still_hard: Avoid misleading simplifications or commentary on live cases.
tasks.human_edge: Explain fairly and respond responsibly to unexpected questions.
tasks.altitude: A small reduction in wording preparation; public accountability stays unchanged.

reach.learn: Distinguish public procedural information from case commentary

evidence.claim: Libra and Legora offer legal drafting and review capabilities; this does not prove suitability for a court or savings on public speeches.
Public explanation drafting and its effort estimates are an unmeasured proposal.

assumptions: Boundary is public general information, excluding adjudication, application of law to case facts and confidential records.
Judge captures audience, topic, exact public source passages/versions, key messages and prohibited case commentary in s1. Capture is counted; absent source support means manual drafting.
Audience questions arise during s3 and are answered by the judge; they are not advance structured inputs to the drafting loop.
Test native templates and approved published explanations first; use a loop only if court policy permits, otherwise retain manual drafting.
unknowns: Court drafting policy and actual preparation effort
research_questions: Can checked drafts simplify language without changing procedural meaning?

already_counted.description: Source pack capture and message selection
Draft review and public delivery including questions

incremental.description: Maintain source pack and drafting instructions
Maintain approved environment and public source access

approvals.approved_version: Exact prepared explanation and source versions; changes require recheck. Spontaneous answers remain human authored during s3

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R95.5 gives4.5 gross minus3 upkeep=1.5 net. Existing public scripts yield zero; repeated audience adaptations may yield0.5%.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Judicial decisions and participation remain human, with limited support for public explanatory drafting.
reach: Work with judicial law clerks on accurate public sources
role.ambitious_version: A judge who communicates clearly while preserving independent and accountable adjudication.
